project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 1 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 6 of 8 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town
touristAppeal.summary: Eardington has recorded local interest, but its current in-boundary visitor offer does not meet the threshold for a tourist-town rating.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Eardington
townGuide.intro: Eardington has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Eardington centre
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Use the map to understand the settlement and its currently curated public facilities.

townGuide.suggestedTime: As part of a wider local journey
townGuide.visitorMood: A local settlement rather than a tourist destination.
